claims.claim: CodeNavigator achieves high faithfulness on repository QA.
CodeNavigator achieves high context recall on repository QA.
claims.evidence: Observed post-fix context recall = 0.8333 (95% CI: [0.733, 0.917], N=10).

claims.claim: The context-builder correction improves context recall and faithfulness compared to trace-only short-circuiting.
claims.evidence: Context recall increased from 0.490 to 0.833 (+0.343), faithfulness increased from 0.552 to 0.833 (+0.281).

claims.claim: The system provides grounded answers using verified citations.
claims.evidence: Golden-set CI 10/10 passed, invalid reference rate = 0.0, post-fix context precision = 0.9185.

claims.claim: CodeNavigator eliminates 100% of hallucinations on all queries.
claims.evidence: Query-level hallucination rate in EXP-A classification audit is 0.2222 (6 FP / 27). Claim of 100% hallucination-free is contradicted by evidence.
